name: let_the_rhythm
title: Let The Rhythm (producer's own drums, 2026-10-18)
notes_format: [pitch, start_beat, duration_beats, velocity], start relative to the loop; loop_beats long; groove applied on top in Live

groove.meaning: every MIDI drum clip except the kick uses 'Swing 16ths 54' at 115 % amount, 30 % velocity, 2 % random: one shared swing (54 % self-referenced), accents from the groove's velocity map

buses.DRUMS: Glue Compressor 2:1, attack 10 ms, auto release, range 4 dB, +1 dB; EQ Eight high shelf -2.5 dB at 9 kHz
buses.SNARECLAP: group fader -2.5 dB (clap+snare were 3x the references' backbeat)
buses.LOW END: kick + bass + sub into one bus: EQ HP 34 Hz 48 dB, Glue 2:1 10 ms 0.2 s range 2.5 dB, Saturator soft sine 2 dB 30 %
buses.returns: A-DRUMVERB shared by almost every drum at -21 to -22.5 dB: one room for the kit

measured.source: finished club master 2026-10-18 (-8.57 LUFS); element timbre from the v6 render whose beat grid was right

hats.reading: 16ths on the beat ~11 dB under the off-beat 8ths; off-beat 16ths 11 ms late

clap.reading: the clap on 2 and 4 lands ~20 ms behind the grid: a laid-back backbeat

measured.caution: the study 'let_the_rhythm' mis-gridded this master (it read a 4-bar intro, swing 79-93 %, kick 48 Hz): use its loudness, bands and width, not its beat-relative numbers

kick.why: Four on the floor, every hit at velocity 127 and one beat long: the Simpler one-shot decides the length, not the note. 'A Bit Warmer' saturator for body. No groove: the kick is the grid everything swings against. 1 beat early cut before breaks (prepared exits).

hat_16ths.why: Every 16th, velocities spread 78-106 with no fixed accent pattern: the motor. Quiet (-10.7 dB) and sidechained, so it is felt more than heard.

hat_off_shaker_shot.why: Off-beat 8ths about 5 ms EARLY (0.489 beat): it pulls the groove forward against the two on-grid layers. A shaker one-shot, not a hat: softer transient, more air. Panned right.

hat_off_persona.why: Off-beat 8ths on the grid, the main open-hat colour. Flu Split widens it.

hat_off_imite.why: A third off-beat layer kept out of groove B1, the breaks and most of the outro: when it comes back the groove lifts without anything new.

shaker_loop.why: A real played shaker loop (122 BPM, warped) under the programmed hats: human 16th movement that MIDI hats do not have. Enters and leaves in chapters, stops 2 beats before drops.

clap.why: Not a plain 2 and 4: beat 2, beat 4 held 3/4 of a beat, a 16th pickup before beat 4 (3.75), the '& of 1' in bar 2 (4.5) and a 32nd velocity ramp before every 8th bar. This syncopated backbeat is half the groove.

snare.why: The same pattern as the clap, layered: snare body + Transient Master under the clap's crack. Both Pro-Q 4 shaped; the group sits -2.5 dB.

congas.why: Percussion Core Kit: low slap, high muted conga, low and high bongo on syncopated 16ths, velocities humanized 62-84, a triplet bar every 4. Gives the 'balanço'; panned right, sidechained.

tom_909.why: 909 low tom on the 'e' and 'a' 16ths (rarely on beats): a rolling counter-rhythm in the mids, out of the bass's register. Sidechained, panned left.

perc_loop.why: A played percussion loop (120 BPM, warped, Beats mode) at -16.5 dB: glue of human timing under the MIDI parts.

ride.why: 909 ride on the off-beats, only in the hook, drop, final groove and groove C. -13.4 dB with a 350 Hz high-pass: louder and full-range it 'took energy away' when it left.

rim_909.why: 909 rim shots on 16th steps 3, 6, 11, 14 with ghost snares at 9 and 13, a 3-rim turn closing every 8 bars, no build. Brought the 'extra movement at the end' where low toms had fought the bass.

ghost_909.why: The producer's own 909 ghost-snare pattern for the intro's second half (bars 9-16), its 16th roll removed: an intro is pulse, not a build.

crash.why: One 909 crash on the downbeat of a new section (groove A, hook, groove B2 after break 1, drop, final groove, groove C), never in builds.

rejected.tribal_toms: 808 low toms (100-200 Hz, off-beat) fought the bass's rhythm
rejected.tribal_congas_3bar: a second conga part in a 3-bar cycle duplicated the producer's congas and never landed on the phrase
rejected.snare_rolls: build rolls are 'apelativo': tension comes from the track's own elements
